Copy dot E N V into place and update dot git ignore.
Paths like /foo dot env and compounds like .envrc stay untouched.
The file config dot yaml sits beside settings dot json.
Edit home dot claude dot json before touching dot claude dot json or dot mcp dot json.
Hidden configs like dot eslintrc dot json and dot prettierrc dot json narrate too.
Bare dotfiles such as .npmrc and .editorconfig are left alone.
